01 / THE STUDIOA MORE PERSONAL PERSPECTIVE

Good design begins
with your life.

Not just how a space looks.
How it lets you live.

At Ashtavinayak Design, we approach interiors as a conversation between the practical and the personal. Light, proportion, materials and the way you move through a room all have a place in the picture.

From the first sketch to the finishing touches, our design philosophy is simple: make room for what matters, and give every detail a purpose.

04 / THE WAY WE WORKA CLEAR PATH FROM IDEA TO INTERIOR

Every detail.
A considered step.

A good interior takes shape through a series of good decisions. Here is how the journey unfolds.

Start with a conversation ↗
  1. 01

    Initial Consultation

    We begin with you: your space, how you use it, your ideas and the scope you have in mind.

  2. 02

    Concept & Planning

    Layouts, mood and an overall direction bring the possibilities into focus.

  3. 03

    Design Development

    The concept becomes a detailed design, with proportions, furniture and lighting working together.

  4. 04

    Material Selection

    Finishes, colours and textures are considered for their feel, practicality and visual harmony.

  5. 05

    Execution & Installation

    The design moves into the space, with coordination and attention to the details that bring it together.

  6. 06

    Final Handover

    The finishing touches are reviewed, and your space is ready for its next chapter.
